visual_briefs.title: A power series changes character when x changes
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Partial sums of the geometric series at an interior, endpoint, and exterior input.
visual_briefs.composition: Partial sums of the geometric series at an interior, endpoint, and exterior input.
visual_briefs.interaction: Move x and watch terms, partial sums, and convergence status change.
visual_briefs.long_description: Three panels show geometric partial sums for x=1/2 approaching 2, for x=-1 oscillating, and for x=2 growing rapidly.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: The radius organizes convergence by distance from the center
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: A number line with an absolute-convergence interior, undecided endpoints, and divergence exterior.
visual_briefs.composition: A number line with an absolute-convergence interior, undecided endpoints, and divergence exterior.
visual_briefs.interaction: Drag the center and radius while endpoint markers remain separately testable.
visual_briefs.long_description: A number line centered at a shows an interior interval of absolute convergence, two separately marked endpoints, and exterior divergence regions.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: A power series converges on an interval centered at its expansion point
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: A number line with an absolute-convergence interior, undecided endpoints, and divergence exterior.
visual_briefs.composition: A number line with an absolute-convergence interior, undecided endpoints, and divergence exterior.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: Inside the radius \(R\), convergence is automatic; outside, divergence is automatic; each endpoint must be checked separately.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Interior, endpoints, and exterior require different reasoning
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Three-zone interval with separate endpoint result cards.
visual_briefs.composition: Three-zone interval with separate endpoint result cards.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: A number line shows an interior region decided by the radius, two endpoint test boxes, and exterior divergence.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Product coefficients come from diagonals
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: A coefficient grid whose diagonals feed successive powers.
visual_briefs.composition: A coefficient grid whose diagonals feed successive powers.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: A grid of coefficient products is organized by total exponent. Entries on the same diagonal all contribute to one power of x.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Differentiation and integration shift coefficients and powers
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Coefficient-and-exponent shifts under differentiation and integration.
visual_briefs.composition: Coefficient-and-exponent shifts under differentiation and integration.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: A row of terms maps downward under differentiation and upward under integration, with exponent multipliers or divisors displayed.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: The geometric series generates a family of expansions
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: A transformation tree branching from the geometric series.
visual_briefs.composition: A transformation tree branching from the geometric series.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: A central geometric-series identity branches through substitution, scaling, differentiation, and integration to several new function series.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Higher Taylor degree matches more local shape
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Function and degree 0, 1, 2, and 3 Taylor models near a common center.
visual_briefs.composition: Function and degree 0, 1, 2, and 3 Taylor models near a common center.
visual_briefs.interaction: Increase degree and watch successive derivatives match.
visual_briefs.long_description: A function near the center is compared with constant, tangent-line, quadratic, and cubic Taylor approximations. Each added degree follows the function farther from the center.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Taylor polynomial approximations
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Function and degree 0, 1, 2, and 3 Taylor models near a common center.
visual_briefs.composition: Function and degree 0, 1, 2, and 3 Taylor models near a common center.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: Increasing the degree makes the polynomial agree with more local derivative data and typically follow the target function over a wider interval.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Derivative cycles generate coefficient patterns
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Derivative cycles for sine, cosine, and exponential functions.
visual_briefs.composition: Derivative cycles for sine, cosine, and exponential functions.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: A four-step cycle shows cosine, negative sine, negative cosine, and sine, with their values at zero determining alternating even-power coefficients.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Taylor accuracy is local to the chosen center
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: The same function with Taylor models centered at two different points.
visual_briefs.composition: The same function with Taylor models centered at two different points.
visual_briefs.interaction: Move the center and compare local approximation error.
visual_briefs.long_description: The same curve is shown with two local polynomial approximations, each closely matching near its own center and separating farther away.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Standard Maclaurin series have visible coefficient patterns
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Aligned pattern rows for exponential, sine, and cosine series.
visual_briefs.composition: Aligned pattern rows for exponential, sine, and cosine series.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: Aligned rows show e to the x using all powers, sine using alternating odd powers, and cosine using alternating even powers.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: New series are built through explicit transformations
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: An operation pipeline with function and series sides updated in parallel.
visual_briefs.composition: An operation pipeline with function and series sides updated in parallel.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: A left-to-right pipeline shows a parent geometric series, differentiation, substitution, and multiplication, with the convergence condition carried below each stage.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Binomial partial sums approximate nonpolynomial powers
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Partial sums approaching sqrt(1+x) or its reciprocal inside the radius.
visual_briefs.composition: Partial sums approaching sqrt(1+x) or its reciprocal inside the radius.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: The curve y equals square root of 1+x is compared with several binomial partial sums on an interval inside the radius of convergence.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: A Taylor polynomial comes with an error envelope
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Function, Taylor polynomial, and an error envelope widening away from the center.
visual_briefs.composition: Function, Taylor polynomial, and an error envelope widening away from the center.
visual_briefs.interaction: Change degree and target point while displaying the certified bound.
visual_briefs.long_description: A function and its Taylor polynomial meet at the center, while symmetric upper and lower error bounds widen with distance from the center.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: A remainder bound encloses the unknown error
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Function, Taylor polynomial, and an error envelope widening away from the center.
visual_briefs.composition: Function, Taylor polynomial, and an error envelope widening away from the center.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: Taylor's theorem does not merely offer a polynomial; it gives an explicit envelope within which the true function must lie.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Polynomial approximations make a nonelementary integral computable
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: The integrand and successive polynomial approximations over the integration interval.
visual_briefs.composition: The integrand and successive polynomial approximations over the integration interval.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: The curve e to the negative x squared is compared with two truncated series on the interval from zero to one half, with the area under each shown.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Sine and angle agree locally but separate farther away
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Sine and the line y=theta near zero, with their separation enlarged.
visual_briefs.composition: Sine and the line y=theta near zero, with their separation enlarged.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: The curves y equals sine theta and y equals theta nearly overlap near zero, while a magnified error panel shows their cubic separation.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: A differential equation becomes a recurrence
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: A coefficient machine mapping a_n to a_{n+1}.
visual_briefs.composition: A coefficient machine mapping a_n to a_{n+1}.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: A flow diagram starts with the initial coefficient a0 and repeatedly applies a_{n+1
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Pointwise error can move instead of disappearing uniformly
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Error envelopes for x^n whose peak remains near one.
visual_briefs.composition: Error envelopes for x^n whose peak remains near one.
visual_briefs.interaction: Increase n and track both pointwise values and the supremum error.
visual_briefs.long_description: Curves x^n on the interval from zero to one become small at each fixed interior point, but their maximum remains near one close to the endpoint.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.
